main_text.p: חָלִי m. Morbus, Infirmitas, Ægritudo: וְחָלֵי רַע Et infirmitas mala, Eccles.6.2. In paula, חָלִי וִידוּעַ Et expertus morbum, Jes.53.3. Aff. חָלְיוֹ Aegritudo ejus, 1.Reg.17. v.17. Plural. וְחָלִים רָעִים Et morbos pessimos, Deut.28. v.59. בְּחָלַיִים Infirmitatibus, 2.Paralip.21.15. Aff. חָלְינוּ Morbos nostros, Jes.53.4.
חֲלִי m. Ornamentum, Monile, Prov.25.12. Plurale, חֲלָאִים Ornamenta, monilia, Cant.7.1.
חֲלִיָּה f. Idem: Aff. חֲלִיָּתָהּ Monili suo, Hos.2.13.
מַחֲלָה m. Morbus, Infirmitas: Constr. בְּמַחֲלֵה מֵעֶיךָ Morbo intestinorum tuorum, 2.Paralip.21.15. Aff. מַחֲלוֹ Aegritudinem ipsius, Prov.18.14.

מַחְלַת Machalath; habet formam constructam antecedentis Nominis; usurpatur tamen tanquam absolutum in titulo Psalmi 53. & 88.R.Salom.dicit, esse Instrumentum musicum sic appellatum: Aben Esra putat esse Initium alicujus suavissimi Carminis, tunc decantari solti [?]: Vide etiam in חלל inter Nomina.

תַּחֲלוּאִים m.p. Idem: מְמוּתֵי תַּחֲלוּאִים Mortibus agritudinum, id est, ægerrimis, Jer.16.4. Constr. תַּחְלוּאֵי רָעָב Aegritudines famis, id est, ob famem, Jer.14.18. Aff. וְאֶת תַּחֲלוּאֵיהָ Et infirmitates ejus, Deut.29.22.

חָלַט Chald. Excidit, Præcidit: unde Partic. ex Aphel in Targum, מְחַלְטָא צוּרְעָא Lepra exscindens, erodens, Lev.13.15. in Jonath. Hinc est, Præcisè, & proprie aliquid facere, Propriù facere, Appropriare: Præcisè, simpliciter, propriè, absolutè dijudicare, adjudicare, cognoscere, pronunciare: unde וִיכַאיְנִיָּה וִיחַלְטִנְיָּה Et impurabit eū, & propriabit eum, Lev.13.11. in Jonathane, id est,

page.notes: Hebrew and Greek-free page. Hebrew vowel points and some Hebrew letters are reproduced from the scan and may contain errors, especially in the Aramaic forms and the points under the letters of the Targum entries. "solti [?]" is read from a blurred word: the scan shows a long-s form that may be "soliti". "eū" in the Lev.13.11 gloss is uncertain. The Latin long s is rendered as s throughout. Printed page-reference forms such as "Jef." for Isaiah were written as "Jes.". The watermark in the bottom right corner is a digitiser's mark and was left out.
